items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I was more interested in Bunk playing at the Stuyvesant on 52nd Street

ctx.x: Well, I remember Johnny used to come there to hear the band at the Stuyvesant in the fall of 45. Yeah. You weren't there then.

I was at school in Eastman and, uh, and hated to be away because I was more interested in Bunk playing at the Stuyvesant on 52nd Street. Yeah. Than being up at Eastman studying the classics. Yeah. So I just stayed one term.
How old were you then about?
